programme.title: Multiplicity
programme.desc: (1996) Comedy starring Michael Keaton and Andie MacDowell. Buckling under stresses at work and home, a man decides to clone himself. But he doesn't tell his wife, causing much confusion.

programme.title: The 355
programme.desc: (2022) Action spy caper with Jessica Chastain, Diane Kruger and Penélope Cruz. A global alliance of elite operatives team up to kick ass and retrieve some stolen world-ending tech.

programme.title: Lean on Pete
programme.desc: (2017) Andrew Haigh's heartstring-tugging equine road movie follows a lad from a poor background and broken home who goes on the run with an ageing racehorse.

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: Teleshopping.

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: Teleshopping.

programme.title: Lifeboat
programme.desc: (1944) Alfred Hitchcock's Oscar-nominated Second World War drama starring Tallulah Bankhead, William Bendix and Walter Slezak as three of the survivors from a liner torpedoed by the Nazis.

programme.title: Sign of the Pagan
programme.desc: (1954) Jack Palance plays Attila the Hun, sweeping across Europe with his hordes and conquering all before him, with Jeff Chandler as the Roman general charged with saving the Empire.

programme.title: Western Union
programme.desc: (1941) American frontier pioneering western starring Randolph Scott, Robert Young and Dean Jagger as three very different men working to connect east and west by telegraph in the 1860s.

programme.title: Rat Race
programme.desc: (2001) Raucous comedy. A Las Vegas casino-owner sets up a unique game for six punters: a race across America, hunting for $2m. Starring John Cleese, Rowan Atkinson and Whoopi Goldberg.

programme.title: Sister Act
programme.desc: (1992) Comedy starring Whoopi Goldberg. A casino singer who witnesses a Mob murder goes into hiding at a convent, where she soon has the choir rocking. With Maggie Smith.

programme.title: Kingsman: The Secret Service
programme.desc: (2014) Action-comedy with Colin Firth, Taron Egerton and Samuel L Jackson. A London teenager is introduced to a secret society of immaculately dressed agents that exists to save the world.

programme.title: Freaky
programme.desc: (2020) Body-swap comedy-horror with Vince Vaughn. A girl gets murdered by a serial killer but then wakes up in his body, with only 24 hours to get her own body back!

programme.title: Zola
